option_relations.rationale: Systemic amyloidosis is a broader class containing various types of amyloidosis, including cutaneous amyloidosis
Systemic AL amyloidosis is a subtype of amyloidosis that can manifest with cutaneous symptoms
Primary systemic (AL) amyloidosis is a subtype of amyloidosis that can manifest with cutaneous symptoms
Multiple myeloma-associated amyloidosis is a different condition, although it can also manifest with amyloidosis
